s94.classification_basis: Gopal: "The welcome line tells me whose server this is, but the name at the top is only 'general', which I have to reason out is a room for messages. The panel covering the bottom half has no heading at all. 'Mallow The Rascal' is a name I cannot place, and I do not know what a 'sticker' is here. The only sign of which part of the panel I am on is a grey shading. The screen is nearly identical to the many before it; only the count of '100's grows, and I could not say how they got there or what I meant to write." — solution: "A plain heading on the panel, such as 'Add a picture to your message', a much clearer mark on the chosen word, and the room named at the top in full, e.g. 'Chat room: general'." (after testing: softened)
s94.disagreement_note: the tester found "general" sufficient to locate the user; Gopal still could not place themselves from it - both hold

tester.deciding_evidence: template carry from s39: same layout and the same top header text, so the content does not change the answer

personas.expectation: I am in the general text channel of Accessibility Testin's server, with the picker panel open at the bottom on the Stickers tab.

personas.why: The channel name is at the top in the same place as every other visit, the server name is written in the middle, and the shaded tab tells me which part of the picker I am in. "Mallow The Rascal" is the name of a sticker set, not a place; I read it as a label for the stickers.

personas.why: The welcome line tells me whose server this is, but the name at the top is only 'general', which I have to reason out is a room for messages. The panel covering the bottom half has no heading at all. 'Mallow The Rascal' is a name I cannot place, and I do not know what a 'sticker' is here. The only sign of which part of the panel I am on is a grey shading. The screen is nearly identical to the many before it; only the count of '100's grows, and I could not say how they got there or what I meant to write.
personas.solution: A plain heading on the panel, such as 'Add a picture to your message', a much clearer mark on the chosen word, and the room named at the top in full, e.g. 'Chat room: general'.

personas.expectation: I am in the general channel with the picker open on the Stickers tab, showing the 'Mallow The Rascal' stickers.
personas.cue: '# general' at the top and 'Stickers' shaded in the tab row.
personas.why: The channel and the chosen tab are both named. The pink rabbit stickers are colourful but kept to the bottom strip.

personas.expectation: Still in #general, with the Stickers tab of the picker open and two rows of 100 emoji in my message box.
personas.cue: '# general' at the top, the big 'Welcome to Accessibility Testin's server' line, and the 'Stickers' tab shaded grey.
personas.why: Channel name at the top, same place every time, and the shaded tab shows which part of the picker I'm in. I've seen this screen many times now and it hasn't let me down. Out of scope: the pink bunny stickers change pose from one picture to the next, so I think they're animated - my eye keeps going there.

s94.recommendation: Gopal: "A plain heading on the panel, such as 'Add a picture to your message', a much clearer mark on the chosen word, and the room named at the top in full, e.g. 'Chat room: general'."

The back arrow then took me to Messages as expected.
